code:
state = zero_state(num_qubits=2)          # |00>
state = apply_gate(kron_gate(H, I), state)
state = apply_gate(CNOT, state)

print(probabilities(state))
# [0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.5]  -- the Bell state
caption: Equal chance of |00> or |11>, never |01> or |10> — exactly what entanglement looks like in numbers.
